text.en: A poet speaks to the mother tongue as to a beloved mother.

Annai Mozhiye is a memorisation poem in which the poet addresses Tamil as mother, calling her the beautiful classical Tamil. It praises the glory, age and sweetness of the language.
The poem teaches love and loyalty to the mother tongue and reminds us that a language is our identity.
Terms: அன்னை (mother), மொழி (language), செந்தமிழ் (refined Tamil) and போற்றுதல் (praise). Learn the poem by heart with its meaning.
